# BAID X: full reference

BAID X is Ghana's work network, built and powered by Baiden Creatives. Canonical site: https://www.baid-x.com/

## What BAID X does
BAID X lets people and businesses in Ghana find verified professionals, hire them, run construction and technical projects, communicate securely, and record payments, in one mobile-first web app.

## Roles
### Workers
Build a verified profile, get found by companies and clients, apply for jobs, join real projects and get paid to your mobile money wallet.
What you get: Verified badge; Job marketplace; Project teams; Wallet & payouts; Career growth; Secure messaging.
Steps: Create your account -> Complete your profile -> Get verified -> Apply and join projects.
Page: https://www.baid-x.com/for/workers/

### Companies
BAID X gives construction and service companies one place to find verified workers and project managers, assign tasks, review reports and approve every payment.
What you get: Verified workforce; Project control; Approval rules; Reports & tasks; Payments & records; Organizations.
Steps: Create your company account -> Create a project -> Invite a project manager and workers -> Approve and pay.
Page: https://www.baid-x.com/for/companies/

### Project managers
Get linked to a company by invitation or join code, build your crew, assign tasks, file reports and request materials, all from your phone.
What you get: Company links; Build your crew; Tasks; Reports; Requests; Reputation.
Steps: Create your account -> Get verified -> Link to a company -> Deliver the project.
Page: https://www.baid-x.com/for/project-managers/

### Suppliers
List building materials, tools and equipment, answer inquiries in chat and reach the companies and project managers who buy for live projects.
What you get: Catalog; Inquiries; Service areas; Verified business; Cover & logo; Wallet.
Steps: Create your business account -> Build your catalog -> Get verified -> Win orders.
Page: https://www.baid-x.com/for/suppliers/

### Individual clients
Whether you need an electrician, plumber, painter or handyman, find verified professionals near you and agree the job in one secure chat.
What you get: Post a job; Find a trade; Message first; Hires record; Verified people; Clear and private.
Steps: Create your account -> Post a job or browse -> Agree details -> Hire and record.
Page: https://www.baid-x.com/for/clients/

## Linking a company and a project manager
1. Invitation: the company creates a project, then invites a verified project manager from the project's Team tab. The project manager accepts, declines or asks a question.
2. Join code: the company creates a one-time code (valid 30 days) under Profile, Team and join code. The project manager enters it under Profile, Link a company. The company approves the link.
3. Organization: the company invites staff into an organization with role-based access.

## Adding workers to a project
Company or project manager invites a verified worker from the project's Team tab with trade, rate and duration. The worker accepts. Per project, the company chooses Automatic (in-plan workers join on accept) or Company approval (every worker waits). Anything outside the plan, and all money (expenses, materials, equipment, payments), always needs company approval.

## Trust and safety
Verification uses a Ghana Card and photos for individuals, and registration, TIN and documents for businesses, reviewed by BAID X staff. The Verified badge is never sold. Messages and files are end-to-end encrypted (device keys, optional passphrase backup). Presence is visible only to people you chat with.

- Support & general: Furniture Assembler, Post-Construction Cleaner, General Handyman (Repairs & Maintenance)

## Pricing and money
Currency is Ghana cedis (GH₵). Paid plans unlock capacity and tools and never change verification. Payments are processed by Paystack. Workers withdraw to mobile money.

## Contact and legal
Terms: https://www.baid-x.com/terms.html . Privacy: https://www.baid-x.com/privacy.html (Ghana Data Protection Act, 2012, Act 843).

## Pricing
Everyone starts on the free Access plan. Pro per month: Worker GH₵30 (founding GH₵20, yearly GH₵288); Project manager GH₵75 (founding GH₵50, yearly GH₵720); Supplier (business) GH₵100 (founding GH₵70, yearly GH₵960); Client (individual) GH₵100 (founding GH₵70, yearly GH₵960); Company GH₵300 (founding GH₵220, yearly GH₵2,880). Details: https://www.baid-x.com/pricing/

## Escrow
Escrow means BAID X holds the client's payment for a job until the work is approved, so the worker knows the money exists and the client only pays for finished work. When the client approves the work, or automatically 3 days after the worker marks the job done if the client does not respond. Either side can report a problem. The job goes into dispute and the money stays held while BAID X reviews it and decides to release or refund. Before the work is submitted the client can cancel and the money goes back to their wallet. A 10% BAID X service fee is deducted from the amount released to the worker. Nothing is charged on a refund, and opening a dispute is free. The worker sees the job total, the fee and the amount received. Clients top up their BAID X wallet through Paystack with card or mobile money. Workers withdraw their earnings to mobile money. Details: https://www.baid-x.com/escrow/

## Verification badges
Verified: The profile has been reviewed by a person at BAID X. Identity verified: A Ghana Card or other official ID has been checked against the person. Professional verified: Trade certificates and proof of past work have been checked, on top of identity. Advanced verified: A full background check on top of identity and trade, for sensitive work. Review fees: Identity verification GH₵10; Professional verification GH₵20; Business verification GH₵25; Advanced verification GH₵35; Enhanced verification GH₵35; Enhanced business verification GH₵50. Details: https://www.baid-x.com/verification/
